evidence.title: DeepSeek's AI Models Are About To Cost Four Times More - engadget.com
evidence.snippet: DeepSeek's AI models are about to cost four times more. Prices at off-peak hours will be half the peak-hour pricing. With the announcement of DeepSeek V4 Pro, the company is raising its API pricing fourfold. The company said it's adopting a new peak and off-peak pricing to "allocate resources more reasonably.". Starting on August 16, the DeepSeek V4 Pro model will cost $3.96 for 1 million output tokens at peak hours, more than four times the current rate of $0.87. It will cost you half that amount ($1.98) during off-peak hours. Meanwhile, the DeepSeek V4 Flash model will set you back $1.32 for 1 million output tokens (from $0.28) during peak hours and $0.66 during off-peak. Even though DeepSeek will soon cost four times more, its V4 models are still a lot more affordable than many of its competitors. evidence.title: Xero shifts to tiered pricing model for developers - Accounting Today
evidence.snippet: Small business accounting platform Xero plans to shift third party app developers from a revenue share commercial model to a new tiered pricing structure based on API usage and connections. Exempted from the new pricing model include bespoke integrations for accountant and bookkeepers built for their own practice or a single client; custom connections; financial services applications in banking, credit and payments that operate on different commercial contracts; apps that solely convert data from other accounting platforms into Xero; and franchise apps built specifically for franchise networks. "As the Xero ecosystem grows, the new tiering model and usage based pricing is designed to meet app partners where they are in their app development journey, making it easier to access benefits, and making it clearer to forecast and control their pricing as they grow and scale.
